notes: MSMR Vol. 32 No. 9, September 2025 (62 pages as served, letter, Adobe InDesign 19.5 / Adobe PDF Library 17, tagged; 4,199,552 bytes; the health.mil archive dates the issue 2025/09/01), cut to pages 1-15 with pypdf. Page 1: cover; pages 2-3: table of contents; pages 4-12: 'Update: Absolute and Relative Morbidity Burdens ... 2024' (no byline), with Figures 1a, 1b, 2 and 3 and a table running over pages 8-11; pages 13-15: the start of 'Update: Hospitalizations Among Active Component Members ... 2024' (no byline; it continues to page 20) with Table 1, Figure 1 and Figure 2 (sixteen small line charts). Page 16 starts with the subsection heading 'Most frequent diagnoses', so 15 is the largest k of at most 15 at whose end a section ends (the second report is cut inside; see holdout6/SELECTION.md for why this issue was the earliest qualifying item). Headings: 'Table of Contents', the two report titles as printed in their banners without the italic 'Update' label above them, the two sidebar headings of each report (listed twice), the letter-spaced section headings in tinted bars and the condensed bold subsection headings; 'Hospitalizations, by ICD-10 major diagnostic categories' is not listed (hyphen). The cover's article list and the underlined titles of the contents pages are not headings. Tables: the multi-page table is transcribed for its first page only (PARTIAL, see its name); Table 1 is complete. Conventions (apply to every tool alike): a superscript note letter after a header or row label is written after one space ('Medical Encounters b', 'Rank d', '... Z codes) c'); the dashes of the ICD-10 code ranges are written as EN DASH U+2013 (assumed from their length; if the text layer holds another code point those label cells match for no tool); the hyphens of 'ICD-10', 'COVID-19', 'ill-defined', 'non-drug', 'Under-dosing' and 'pregnancy-related' are written as ASCII hyphen-minus (assumed); group rows leave the rank and 'Individuals Affected' cells empty, as printed; merged and blank positions are empty strings (not scored). Arithmetic checked while typing (a throwaway script): the 17 injury rows sum to the group's 3,340,649 encounters and 42,962 bed days, the 9 mental-disorder rows to 2,660,116 and 195,726, exactly; in Table 1 each year's 18 category counts (the female-only rate row repeats the pregnancy count and is not summed) add up to the Total row exactly, every rate equals count / (total / total rate) within 0.06, and every rank follows the counts. must_contain: 58 phrases, each printed once in the kept pages, none crossing a page break or a column break: the cover's publisher line, summaries and two author lines of the contents pages, sentences of both reports (several of them across line-end hyphenations, e.g. 'interventions', 'substantially', 'facilities', 'January', 'standardized'), sidebar sentences, figure captions between their superscript letters, table notes and two references. Phrases avoid every true hyphen ('20-24', 'COVID-19', 'non-military', 'one-third', 'p-yrs', 'person-years'), the em dashes, the curly quotes and apostrophes ('MSMR's', 'population's'), the drop caps and the superscript citation numbers. The serif body font sets a 'Th' ligature at the start of 'This', 'The', 'There' and 'These'; that glyph has no Unicode code point of its own, so phrases and anchors leave out such a leading word ('annual summary report of ...' for 'This annual summary report of ...'); the 'fi', 'ff' and 'ffi' ligatures of words such as 'quantifies', 'profiles' and 'affected' are assumed to map to their letters or to U+FB00-FB06, which NFKC turns into letters (if the text layer maps them otherwise, the phrases holding them match for no tool). ordered: 8 anchors on pages 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 11, 13 and 15. Noise: the footer issue line is printed on every kept page but the cover, as 'MSMR Vol. 32 No. 9 September 2025' on even pages (7 times) and 'September 2025 Vol. 32 No. 9 MSMR' on odd pages (7 times), and occurs nowhere in the body (the cover prints 'September 2025 | Vol. 32 | No. 9' after the journal name, without 'MSMR' around it); max 1 each (one kept copy is tolerated). 'Page N' is too short and is not counted. Absent: 14 words broken by a line-end hyphen in the justified columns (pages 4, 5, 11, 13, 14 and 15), written as '<first part>- <rest>'; the line-end hyphen is assumed to be an ASCII hyphen-minus (if the text layer holds a soft hyphen or another code point the entries count nothing for every tool alike). Line-end hyphens inside true compounds ('non-' + 'communicable', 'pol-' + 'icy-makers') are not used. BLIND PROTOCOL: chosen and answered before any converter or text extractor was run on the file; every check was typed from the rendered pages (pdftoppm at 40-400 dpi, read as images), and the PDF text layer was never read. Consequences: (1) text that may be an image (logos, seals, signatures, photographs, chart art) is not checked; (2) invisible text-layer content cannot be known, so noise lists only VISIBLE repeated page furniture; (3) where the exact code point of a glyph cannot be seen (curly vs straight quotes, dash and minus variants, line-end hyphens), must_contain phrases and ordered anchors avoid it; headings, table cells and absent entries that cannot avoid it are noted per file.
